## Safety net: the reconciliation sweep
Every 15 minutes (or on `POST /webhook/screening/sweep`) the sweep fails any claim stuck in *processing* into the dead-letter queue, then reads every page of the portal's **New** list and screens whatever has no live claim. The HTTP node pages through the list until the pager says there is no next page.

parameters.query: select jsonb_object_agg(key, value) as settings from settings;

-- A run still "processing" after 10 minutes died without reaching an error
-- branch (a restart mid-run). Fail it into the dead-letter queue.
with stale as (
  update runs set status = 'failed', error_code = 'STALE_CLAIM',
    error_detail = 'still processing after 10 minutes', finished_at = now()
  where status = 'processing' and started_at < now() - interval '10 minutes'
  returning id, application_id, n8n_execution_id
)
insert into dead_letters (application_id, run_id, source, error_code, error_detail, workflow, retryable, n8n_execution_id)
select application_id, id, 'sweep', 'STALE_CLAIM', 'still processing after 10 minutes', 'Intake · Reconciliation sweep', true, n8n_execution_id
from stale
returning id;
